d:
Three oil tankers reportedly caught fire after explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iran's Revolutionary Guard. Tehran claims the vessels were using unauthorised shipping routes and has warned ships against violating its rules. The incident comes amid escalating tensions between Iran and the United States over control of the strategic waterway, through which a significant share of the world's oil supply passes.
